subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose Gateway update execution to HTTP-authenticated operator callers, and if so should it be a new endpoint, an Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`, or an external-updater control surface?
rationale: The request expands host package-update and restart authority from existing Gateway control-plane paths to an HTTP surface and adds target-version semantics that current `update.run` does not support.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower canonical issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the default-off Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, handoff, and target-version proof requirements.

options.title: Decline HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower canonical issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses Gateway update flow, Admin HTTP RPC, and security documentation, all areas tied to this owner history.
